title: 第一卷 风起时 第十三章 一杀再杀第一卷 风起时 第十四章 狭路相逢报仇而已
content_zh:
;;
“还有这种事？”
青年远远凝视着陈风奇，轻轻呢喃一声后，挥了挥手。
在他的身后，立时又出现了五道身影。
随后他们与青年一起，以极快的速度朝着陈风奇包围过去。
陈风奇眸光一寒，看出了他们的来者不善，也不想在这陌生的环境下去以寡敌众。
所以他的第一反应就是将异骨收入怀中，起身朝另一个方向跑去，打算先离开这里再说。
远方的青年见他要走，当即大喊道：“陈兄，才一年多不见，就认不得我了？”
陈风奇在听到此言后，心中微动，暗道自己方才的感觉果然没错，对方认得自己。
但他却记得很清楚，自己从未与对方有过任何交集。
换而言之，对方认出的不是他，而是那位与他有着相同样貌的双胞胎哥哥，陈风骨！
在想到这一层后，陈风奇改变了想法，当真停下了步伐，不再逃跑。
那六人的速度很快，不过几个呼吸之间，就已经冲至近前。
陈风奇在他们冲过来的时候，目光就已经在六人身上一一扫过，根据他们的精神气和速度，大致判断出了几人的修为。
其中有五人，都在凝气四层。
修为最高的是叫住他的那位青年，应该有凝气五层修为，大概是这几人中的首领。
青年来到陈风奇的前方，上下打量，脸上诧异的神色也越来越浓。
其余五人则十分有默契地站在了五个方向，将陈风奇团团包围，阻断了他的退路。
“没想到啊没想到，我图灵还有能活着见到陈兄的这一天。”青年笑声道。
陈风奇冷眼看着他，没有说话。

图灵却摊了摊手，自顾说了起来。
“陈兄，别用这种眼神看我，当初那件事可怪不了我，本意上我也是想帮你的。”
“要怪就怪你太固执，为了一株宝药，不仅放弃了一个机会，还差点丢了性命。”
“我为此可还愧疚了好久。”
“万幸，你还活着，也算是给了我一个弥补的机会，就先跟我们走一趟吧！”
“所以……”
陈风奇终于开口了，问道：“你们是龟甲村的人？”
当初，陈风骨在重伤回到百丈山后，只告诉陈风奇以后要小心龟甲村的人。
至于具体发生过什么，陈风奇就不太知道了。
陈风骨很清楚自己这个弟弟的性格，一旦让其知晓了前因后果，必然会想方设法去为他报仇。
可身为兄长，他不想让弟弟因为此事去冒险，乃至步了他的后尘。
故而，他除了留下一句告诫，其余什么都没有多说。
但此刻，陈风奇根据图灵的话，已经将当初陈风骨重伤的事，猜了一个大概。
而图灵在听到陈风奇的话后，明显愣了一下，随即笑道：“怎么？陈兄难道当真不记得了？你我好歹也合作过……”
“我问你，是不是龟甲村的？”
陈风奇神色渐冷，直接打断道。
图灵此时也回过味来，再次细细打量起眼前的陈风奇。
虽然对方的相貌与记忆中的一样，可在很多方面，又似乎有所不同。

"Is there such a thing?"
The young man stared at Chen Fengqi from a distance, murmured softly, and waved.
Behind him, five more figures immediately appeared.
Then, together with the young man, they surrounded Chen Fengqi at extremely fast speeds.
Chen Fengqi's eyes turned cold, he could tell that they came with bad intentions, and he didn't want to be outnumbered in this unfamiliar environment.
So his first reaction was to put the alien bone into his arms, get up and run in the other direction, planning to leave here first.
When the young man in the distance saw that he was leaving, he immediately shouted: "Brother Chen, we haven't seen you for more than a year and you don't recognize me anymore?"
After Chen Fengqi heard this, his heart moved slightly, and he secretly thought that his feeling just now was indeed correct, the other party recognized him.
But he remembered clearly that he had never had any interaction with the other party.
In other words, what the other party recognized was not him, but the twin brother who had the same appearance as him, Chen Fenggu!
After thinking about this, Chen Fengqi changed his mind and stopped running away.
The six people were very fast, and within a few breaths, they had already rushed forward.
When they rushed over, Chen Fengqi's eyes had already scanned the six people one by one. Based on their energy and speed, he roughly judged the cultivation level of several people.
其中有五人，都在凝气四层。
The young man with the highest level of cultivation was the young man who stopped him. He should have the fifth level of Qi Condensation and was probably the leader among these people.
The young man came to the front of Chen Fengqi and looked up and down, the look of surprise on his face getting stronger and stronger.
The remaining five people stood in five directions with a tacit understanding, surrounding Chen Fengqi and blocking his retreat.
"I didn't expect that I, Turing, would still be alive to see Brother Chen." The young man laughed.
陈风奇冷眼看着他，没有说话。
图灵却摊了摊手，自顾说了起来。
"Brother Chen, don't look at me like that. You can't blame me for what happened in the first place. I also wanted to help you."
"If I'm to blame, I blame you for being too stubborn. Not only did you give up an opportunity, but you almost lost your life for a precious medicine."
“我为此可还愧疚了好久。”
"Fortunately, you are still alive, which gives me a chance to make amends. Please come with us first!"
"So..."
Chen Fengqi finally spoke and asked, "Are you from Guijia Village?"
At first, after Chen Fenggu returned to Baizhang Mountain after being seriously injured, he only told Chen Fengqi to be careful of the people in Guijia Village in the future.
As for what happened specifically, Chen Fengqi didn't know much.
Chen Fenggu knew the character of his younger brother very well. Once he knew the cause and effect, he would definitely find ways to avenge him.
But as the elder brother, he didn't want his younger brother to take risks because of this matter, or even follow in his footsteps.
Therefore, except for leaving a warning, he said nothing more.
But at this moment, based on Turing's words, Chen Fengqi had made a rough guess about Chen Fenggu's serious injury.
After Turing heard Chen Fengqi's words, he was obviously stunned for a moment, and then smiled and said: "What? Brother Chen, do you really not remember? You and I have collaborated before..."
“我问你，是不是龟甲村的？”
陈风奇神色渐冷，直接打断道。
Turing also came back to his senses at this time and carefully looked at Chen Fengqi in front of him again.
Although the other party's appearance is the same as in memory, it seems to be different in many aspects.
